what: STERIS supplies infection prevention to hospitals. It makes sterilisers and washers, sells the detergents and consumables that run in them, repairs surgical instruments, and operates facilities that sterilise medical devices for manufacturers.
customers: Hospitals and surgery centres, medical device manufacturers, and pharmaceutical and research laboratories.
money: sterilisers, consumables, surgical instrument repair and service
moat: Equipment installed in hospital sterile processing departments that runs on its own consumables and needs its service, plus contract sterilisation plants that are very hard to permit.
risks: Hospital capital spending can be deferred in tight budget years
Ethylene oxide sterilisation faces environmental litigation and regulation industry-wide
opportunities: Revenue grew about 9% last year and about 9% a year over three years
Surgical procedure volumes have recovered and keep growing with an ageing population
Consumables and service are the majority of revenue and recur automatically
watch: Procedure volume growth and Applied Sterilization Technologies capacity.
